glossary.Token: A named design constant, such as a colour or a spacing step, defined once in jupiter.tokens.json and generated into every target.
glossary.Graphic: A one-stroke SVG from the graphics set: an icon, a spot illustration, a scene or a rule.
glossary.Project: A repository with a docs.config.json and a docs-src folder. Its pages appear on this site under the project's id.
